pipelines.name: Fix OBI submodule CI

steps.name: Wait for all CI checks to complete
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

# Exact names to exclude (our own workflow and the supervisor)
EXCLUDED_NAMES='["Fix OBI submodule CI","CI Supervisor: Rerun flaky failures","Wait for CI completion","Triage CI failures","Plan fixes","Implement and push","Remove agent label","Evaluate failed checks","Add agent/fix-obi label","Add agent/fix-obi-pending label","Handle CI completion","Request Copilot review"]'

# Retry wrapper for transient GitHub API errors (e.g. 401 token refresh race)
gh_retry() {
  local attempt
  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
    if output=$("$@" 2>&1); then
      echo "$output"
      return 0
    fi
    echo "::warning::API call failed (attempt ${attempt}/3): $output" >&2
    sleep 10
  done
  echo "::error::API call failed after 3 attempts" >&2
  return 1
}

echo "Waiting for all CI checks on PR #${PR_NUMBER} to complete..."

while true; do
  HEAD_SHA=$(gh_retry gh pr view "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$REPO" --json headRefOid --jq '.headRefOid')

  # Build set of check-suite IDs from pull_request-triggered workflow runs.
  # This excludes schedule/workflow_dispatch/push runs that share the same SHA,
  # matching the approach in scripts/release-train.sh:check_ci_green().
  PR_SUITE_IDS=$(
    gh_retry gh api --paginate -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
      "repos/${REPO}/actions/runs?head_sha=${HEAD_SHA}&event=pull_request&per_page=100" \
      | jq -s '[ map(.workflow_runs // []) | add // [] | .[].check_suite_id ]'
  )

  # Fetch all check-runs, filter to PR suites + non-Actions apps, deduplicate by name.
  ALL_CHECKS=$(
    gh_retry gh api --paginate -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
      "repos/${REPO}/commits/${HEAD_SHA}/check-runs?per_page=100" \
      | jq -s '{check_runs: ((map(.check_runs // []) | add) // [])}'
  )

  CHECKS_JSON=$(
    echo "$ALL_CHECKS" \
      | jq --argjson pr_suites "$PR_SUITE_IDS" --argjson excluded "$EXCLUDED_NAMES" \
        '{check_runs: [
          .check_runs[]
          | select(
              .app.slug != "github-actions"
              or (.check_suite.id as $id | $pr_suites | index($id))
            )
          | select(
              (.name as $n | $excluded | index($n)) | not
            )
        ]}' \
      | jq '{check_runs: [.check_runs | group_by(.name) | .[] | sort_by(.id) | last]}'
  )

  TOTAL=$(echo "$CHECKS_JSON" | jq '.check_runs | length')
  PENDING=$(echo "$CHECKS_JSON" | jq '[.check_runs[] | select(.status != "completed")] | length')

  if [ "$TOTAL" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "No CI checks found yet. Waiting 60s..."
    sleep 60
    continue
  fi

  if [ "$PENDING" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "All ${TOTAL} CI checks have completed."

    # Log any non-green checks for visibility
    NON_GREEN=$(echo "$CHECKS_JSON" | jq -r '[.check_runs[] | select(.conclusion != "success" and .conclusion != "neutral" and .conclusion != "skipped")] | length')
    if [ "$NON_GREEN" -gt 0 ]; then
      echo "Warning: ${NON_GREEN} check(s) are not green:"
      echo "$CHECKS_JSON" | jq -r '.check_runs[] | select(.conclusion != "success" and .conclusion != "neutral" and .conclusion != "skipped") | "  - \(.name): \(.conclusion // "none")"'
    fi
    break
  fi

  echo "${PENDING} of ${TOTAL} checks still pending. Waiting 60s..."
  sleep 60
done

free_kib() {

  return "$status"
}

bump-chart.name: Bump Helm chart appVersion and version

steps.name: Validate input
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ ! "${VERSION_TAG}" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::Invalid version tag: ${VERSION_TAG}. Expected vX.Y.Z"
  exit 1
fi
APP_VERSION="${VERSION_TAG#v}"
echo "app_version=${APP_VERSION}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

steps.name: Read current Chart.yaml values
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
CURRENT_APP_VERSION=$(grep '^appVersion:' charts/beyla/Chart.yaml | awk '{print $2}')
CURRENT_CHART_VERSION=$(grep '^version:' charts/beyla/Chart.yaml | awk '{print $2}')
echo "app_version=${CURRENT_APP_VERSION}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
echo "chart_version=${CURRENT_CHART_VERSION}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

steps.name: Determine last released chart version
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# GitHub's /releases API sorts by created_at, not semver, and helm-charts
# often stamps several beyla-* tags with the same created_at. Take the
# highest beyla-X.Y.Z tag instead of the first API result.
TAGS=$(gh api --paginate repos/grafana/helm-charts/git/matching-refs/tags/beyla- -q '.[].ref')
RELEASED_VERSION=$(printf '%s\n' "${TAGS}" | sed 's|^refs/tags/beyla-||' | { grep -E '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' || true; } | sort -V | tail -1)
if [[ -z "${RELEASED_VERSION}" ]]; then
  echo "::warning::No beyla release found on grafana/helm-charts, will bump chart version"
fi
echo "chart_version=${RELEASED_VERSION}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
echo "Last released chart version: ${RELEASED_VERSION:-none}"

steps.name: Compute new chart version
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

# Check if appVersion already matches
if [[ "${CURRENT_APP_VERSION}" == "${NEW_APP_VERSION}" ]]; then
  echo "::notice::appVersion already matches ${NEW_APP_VERSION}"
  {
    echo "app_version_changed=false"
    echo "new_chart_version=${CURRENT_CHART_VERSION}"
    echo "chart_version_changed=false"
  } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
  exit 0
fi
echo "app_version_changed=true" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

# Helm indexes charts by `version`, not `appVersion`. Always patch-bump
# version when shipping a new Beyla release so helm repo update sees it.
# Base the bump on the greater of Chart.yaml and the last published
# grafana/helm-charts version so we never reuse a version already on the repo.
if [[ -n "${RELEASED_CHART_VERSION}" ]]; then
  BASE_CHART_VERSION=$(printf '%s\n' "${CURRENT_CHART_VERSION}" "${RELEASED_CHART_VERSION}" | sort -V | tail -1)
else
  BASE_CHART_VERSION="${CURRENT_CHART_VERSION}"
fi
IFS='.' read -r MAJOR MINOR PATCH <<< "${BASE_CHART_VERSION}"
NEW_CHART_VERSION="${MAJOR}.${MINOR}.$((PATCH + 1))"
{
  echo "new_chart_version=${NEW_CHART_VERSION}"
  echo "chart_version_changed=true"
} >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
echo "Chart version: ${CURRENT_CHART_VERSION} -> ${NEW_CHART_VERSION} (patch bump from ${BASE_CHART_VERSION}, last released: ${RELEASED_CHART_VERSION:-none})"

steps.name: Check if any changes needed
steps.run:
if [[ "${APP_VERSION_CHANGED}" == "false" && "${CHART_VERSION_CHANGED}" == "false" ]]; then
  echo "::notice::No changes needed -- Chart.yaml is already up to date"
  echo "skip=true" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
else
  echo "skip=false" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
fi

steps.name: Update Chart.yaml
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
sed -i "s/^appVersion:.*/appVersion: ${NEW_APP_VERSION}/" charts/beyla/Chart.yaml
sed -i "s/^version:.*/version: ${NEW_CHART_VERSION}/" charts/beyla/Chart.yaml
echo "Updated Chart.yaml:"
grep -E '^(version|appVersion):' charts/beyla/Chart.yaml

  --json tagName,isPrerelease 2>/dev/null); then
  echo "::error::GitHub release for ${VERSION_TAG} not found"

steps.name: Evaluate and rerun flaky failures
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

MAX_ATTEMPTS=2

# --- Resolve the associated PR ---
PR_NUMBER=$(gh api "repos/${REPO}/actions/runs/${RUN_ID}" --jq '.pull_requests[0].number // empty' 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "$PR_NUMBER" ]; then
  echo "No PR associated with run ${RUN_ID}. Exiting."
  exit 0
fi
# Validate PR number is a positive integer
if ! echo "$PR_NUMBER" | grep -qE '^[0-9]+$'; then
  echo "Invalid PR number: ${PR_NUMBER}. Exiting."
  exit 1
fi
echo "PR #${PR_NUMBER} -- workflow: ${WORKFLOW_NAME}"
echo "pr_number=${PR_NUMBER}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

# --- Get run details ---
RUN_JSON=$(gh run view "$RUN_ID" --repo "$REPO" --json attempt,jobs,name)
ATTEMPT=$(echo "$RUN_JSON" | jq -r '.attempt')
echo "Current attempt: ${ATTEMPT}"

# --- Check attempt limit first ---
VERDICT="rerun"
REASON=""
if [ "$ATTEMPT" -ge "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then
  VERDICT="skip"
  REASON="Maximum re-run attempts reached (attempt ${ATTEMPT} of ${MAX_ATTEMPTS})"
fi

# --- Scan this workflow's failed jobs ---
FOUND_FAILURE=0

while IFS= read -r job_name; do
  FOUND_FAILURE=1
  # Unrecoverable: lint failure in "Pull request checks" -- re-run won't help
  if [ "$WORKFLOW_NAME" = "Pull request checks" ] && echo "$job_name" | grep -qi "lint"; then
    if [ "$VERDICT" != "skip" ]; then
      VERDICT="skip"
      REASON="Lint job failed in '${WORKFLOW_NAME}' -- compile-level problem, re-run will not help"
    fi
  fi
done < <(echo "$RUN_JSON" | jq -r '.jobs[] | select(.conclusion == "failure" or .conclusion == "timed_out") | .name')

if [ "$FOUND_FAILURE" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "No failed or timed-out jobs found. Exiting."
  exit 0
fi

# --- Take action ---
SHOULD_LABEL="false"
if [ "$VERDICT" = "rerun" ]; then
  echo "Re-running failed jobs for run ${RUN_ID}..."
  gh run rerun "$RUN_ID" --repo "$REPO" --failed
else
  echo "Skipping re-run: ${REASON}"

  MAX_AGENT_RUNS=5
  PR_JSON=$(gh pr view "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$REPO" --json labels,headRefName)
  HAS_AUTOMATED=$(echo "$PR_JSON" | jq '[.labels[].name] | any(. == "automated-pr")')
  HAS_AGENT=$(echo "$PR_JSON" | jq '[.labels[].name] | any(. == "agent/fix-obi" or . == "agent/fix-obi-pending")')
  HEAD_BRANCH=$(echo "$PR_JSON" | jq -r '.headRefName')
  AGENT_LABEL_COUNT=0
  PAGE=1
  while [ "$AGENT_LABEL_COUNT" -lt "$MAX_AGENT_RUNS" ] && [ "$PAGE" -le 20 ]; do
    PAGE_JSON=$(gh api --method GET \
      -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
      "repos/${REPO}/actions/workflows/agent_fix-obi.yml/runs" \
      -f "branch=${HEAD_BRANCH}" \
      -F per_page=100 \
      -F "page=${PAGE}" \
      -F exclude_pull_requests=true)
    BATCH=$(echo "$PAGE_JSON" | jq '[.workflow_runs[] | select(.conclusion != "skipped")] | length')
    PAGE_SIZE=$(echo "$PAGE_JSON" | jq '.workflow_runs | length')
    AGENT_LABEL_COUNT=$((AGENT_LABEL_COUNT + BATCH))
    if [ "$PAGE_SIZE" -lt 100 ]; then
      break
    fi
    PAGE=$((PAGE + 1))
  done
  echo "agent/fix-obi has started ${AGENT_LABEL_COUNT}/${MAX_AGENT_RUNS} times on ${HEAD_BRANCH}"
  echo "label_count=${AGENT_LABEL_COUNT}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "max_label_runs=${MAX_AGENT_RUNS}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  if [ "$HAS_AUTOMATED" = "true" ] && [ "$HAS_AGENT" = "false" ]; then
    if [ "$AGENT_LABEL_COUNT" -ge "$MAX_AGENT_RUNS" ]; then
      echo "Maximum agent/fix-obi attempts (${MAX_AGENT_RUNS}) reached -- not relabelling"
    else
      SHOULD_LABEL="true"
    fi
  fi
fi

echo "should_label=${SHOULD_LABEL}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Add pending label and promote if CI is already complete
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

# Re-read labels. evaluate-and-rerun's should_label snapshot races
# handle-ci-completion, which may already have promoted pending.
LABELS=$(gh pr view "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$REPO" --json labels --jq '[.labels[].name]')
HAS_PENDING=$(echo "$LABELS" | jq 'any(. == "agent/fix-obi-pending")')
HAS_FIX=$(echo "$LABELS" | jq 'any(. == "agent/fix-obi")')
if [ "$HAS_PENDING" = "true" ] || [ "$HAS_FIX" = "true" ]; then
  echo "PR #${PR_NUMBER} already has an agent label. Not adding agent/fix-obi-pending."
  exit 0
fi

echo "Adding agent/fix-obi-pending label to PR #${PR_NUMBER}"
gh pr edit "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$REPO" --add-label "agent/fix-obi-pending"

# Check if all CI checks are already complete — if so, promote immediately.
# This handles the edge case where the failing workflow was the last to complete.
EXCLUDED_NAMES='["Fix OBI submodule CI","CI Supervisor: Rerun flaky failures","Wait for CI completion","Triage CI failures","Plan fixes","Implement and push","Remove agent label","Evaluate failed checks","Add agent/fix-obi-pending label","Handle CI completion","Request Copilot review"]'

HEAD_SHA=$(gh pr view "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$REPO" --json headRefOid --jq '.headRefOid')

PR_SUITE_IDS=$(
  gh api --paginate -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
    "repos/${REPO}/actions/runs?head_sha=${HEAD_SHA}&event=pull_request&per_page=100" \
    | jq -s '[ map(.workflow_runs // []) | add // [] | .[].check_suite_id ]'
)

ALL_CHECKS=$(
  gh api --paginate -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
    "repos/${REPO}/commits/${HEAD_SHA}/check-runs?per_page=100" \
    | jq -s '{check_runs: ((map(.check_runs // []) | add) // [])}'
)

CHECKS_JSON=$(
  echo "$ALL_CHECKS" \
    | jq --argjson pr_suites "$PR_SUITE_IDS" --argjson excluded "$EXCLUDED_NAMES" \
      '{check_runs: [
        .check_runs[]
        | select(
            .app.slug == "github-actions"
            and (.check_suite.id as $id | $pr_suites | index($id))
          )
        | select(
            (.name as $n | $excluded | index($n)) | not
          )
      ]}' \
    | jq '{check_runs: [.check_runs | group_by(.name) | .[] | sort_by(.id) | last]}'
)

TOTAL=$(echo "$CHECKS_JSON" | jq '.check_runs | length')
PENDING=$(echo "$CHECKS_JSON" | jq '[.check_runs[] | select(.status != "completed")] | length')

if [ "$TOTAL" -gt 0 ] && [ "$PENDING" -eq 0 ]; then
  # Live re-read. This run holds the per-commit concurrency group,
  # so the other writer here is a person adding agent/fix-obi while
  # the check list above was in flight.
  LIVE=$(gh pr view "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$REPO" --json labels --jq '[.labels[].name]')
  if echo "$LIVE" | jq -e 'any(. == "agent/fix-obi")' >/dev/null; then
    echo "agent/fix-obi is already set. Removing stale pending label only."
    gh pr edit "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$REPO" --remove-label "agent/fix-obi-pending" || true
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "All ${TOTAL} CI checks already complete — promoting to agent/fix-obi"
  if ! gh pr edit "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$REPO" --remove-label "agent/fix-obi-pending"; then
    echo "agent/fix-obi-pending was already removed. Not adding agent/fix-obi."
    exit 0
  fi
  if ! gh pr edit "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$REPO" --add-label "agent/fix-obi"; then
    gh pr edit "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$REPO" --add-label "agent/fix-obi-pending" || true
    exit 1
  fi

  # This PR is always automated-pr (evaluate-and-rerun only sets should-label for automated PRs).
  # If checks are also all green, request Copilot review since handle-ci-completion won't re-fire.
  NON_GREEN=$(echo "$CHECKS_JSON" | jq '[.check_runs[] | select(.conclusion != "success" and .conclusion != "neutral" and .conclusion != "skipped")] | length')
  if [ "$NON_GREEN" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "All checks green — requesting Copilot review"
    gh api --method POST \
      -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
      "repos/${REPO}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/requested_reviewers" \
      -f "reviewers[]=Copilot"
  fi
else
  echo "${PENDING} of ${TOTAL} checks still pending — handle-ci-completion job will promote when CI completes"
fi

steps.name: Pre-build Docker images for VM tests
steps.run:
# Auto-discover Docker images from compose files and build them on
# the host at native speed, avoiding slow in-VM builds under QEMU
# TCG (software CPU emulation). Scans for services that have both a
# 'build: dockerfile:' and 'image: hatest-*', skipping entries with
# env var substitutions in the dockerfile path.
mapfile -t ENTRIES < <(
  awk '
    /^  [a-zA-Z]/ {
      if (df && img && !(img in seen)) { seen[img]=1; print img "=" df }
      df=""; img=""
    }
    /dockerfile:/ {
      sub(/.*dockerfile: */, ""); gsub(/["'"'"']/, ""); sub(/^\.\/*/, "")
      if ($0 !~ /\$\{/) df=$0
    }
    /image: *hatest-/ { sub(/.*image: */, ""); img=$0 }
    END { if (df && img && !(img in seen)) print img "=" df }
  ' internal/testgenerated/integration/docker-compose-multiexec*.yml | sort
)

echo "Discovered ${#ENTRIES[@]} Docker images to pre-build"
IMAGE_TAGS=()
for entry in "${ENTRIES[@]}"; do
  tag="${entry%%=*}"
  dockerfile="${entry#*=}"
  # Beyla extension Dockerfiles (beyla_extensions/) live in the Beyla
  # repo root; OBI component Dockerfiles live under .obi-src/.
  if [[ "$dockerfile" == *beyla_extensions* ]]; then
    context="./"
  else
    context=".obi-src/"
  fi
  echo "Building ${tag} from ${dockerfile} (context: ${context})..."
  # -f is relative to CWD, not context, so prepend context path
  docker build --quiet -t "${tag}" -f "${context}${dockerfile}" "${context}"
  IMAGE_TAGS+=("${tag}")
done

if [ ${#IMAGE_TAGS[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "Saving ${#IMAGE_TAGS[@]} Docker images to tar..."
  docker save "${IMAGE_TAGS[@]}" -o compiled-tests/docker-images.tar
  echo "Docker images saved ($(du -h compiled-tests/docker-images.tar | cut -f1))"
  docker builder prune -af
fi

steps.name: Free up disk space
steps.run:
# Keep Docker images for loading the cached prep artifact.
# Report each operation separately to identify expensive cleanup work.
free_kib() {
  df -Pk / | awk 'NR == 2 {print $4}'
}

cleanup() {
  local label="$1"
  shift
  local started=$SECONDS before after status=0
  before=$(free_kib)
  echo "::group::${label}"
  "$@" || status=$?
  after=$(free_kib)
  echo "${label}: $((SECONDS - started))s, $(((after - before) / 1024)) MiB reclaimed, $((after / 1024)) MiB available (exit ${status})"
  echo "::endgroup::"
  return "$status"
}
